Memorial Day weekend officially launches Arizona summer. Temperatures climb toward triple digits and the Valley answers with lake days, pool parties and backyard barbecues. Here is how to get everywhere without fighting lake traffic or arguing over a designated driver, with the vehicles and rates we actually book.

Memorial Day in Arizona

The Experience

  • Weather: 100 to 105°F
  • Lakes: Packed with boats and swimmers
  • Pools: Resort day clubs and private parties
  • Events: Parades, ceremonies and remembrances
  • Traffic: Lake-bound congestion all weekend

Popular Destinations

  • Lake Pleasant: northwest of Phoenix off Carefree Highway
  • Saguaro Lake: northeast of Scottsdale off the Beeline Highway
  • Canyon Lake: east of Mesa along the Apache Trail
  • Resort pools: Valley-wide
  • Private parties: Backyards everywhere

Lake Transportation

The Lake Traffic Problem

Friday afternoon I-17 north crawls. Saturday morning the early departures back up. Sunday is congested all day, and Monday's return is the worst of all.

Our Lake Solution

An early departure with relaxed passengers, a chauffeur who absorbs the traffic stress, drinks for the adults on the way, and nobody driving home tired and sunburned.

Lake Pleasant

Our Lake Pleasant tour runs in the Executive Sprinter or a party bus: multi-household pickups, cooler and gear transport, a designated driver for the whole day and a cool ride home.

Saguaro Lake

The closest major lake. Kayaking, paddleboarding and beach access. Luxury SUV or Executive Sprinter.

Canyon Lake

Apache Trail scenery, steamboat dinner cruises and dramatic desert-lake views. A full day-trip service.

The Lake Day Itinerary

  • 7:00 AM: Pickup, ahead of the heat and the traffic
  • 8:00 AM: Lake arrival, claim your spot
  • 3:00 PM: Pickup in a pre-cooled vehicle
  • 4:00 PM: Home for a shower
  • 6:00 PM: Optional dinner run

Pool Party Transportation

Resort Day Clubs

The Memorial Day pool circuit: the W Scottsdale (DJ-driven), Sanctuary on Camelback (upscale lounging), Talking Stick Resort (casino and pool) and the downtown Phoenix rooftops. We drop at the resort, pick up when you text and keep the evening going if you want.

Private Pool Parties

Multiple guest pickups, flexible timing, drinks welcome for the adults and safe returns. The Executive Sprinter for up to 14, the Party Bus (28 Pax) for up to 28, and the 56-Passenger Motorcoach for the big crowd.

Drinking on Board

Adults can drink on the way to the lake or the pool. Arizona's open-container law, A.R.S. § 4-251, exempts passengers in a vehicle for hire such as a party bus or limousine. It is BYOB, everyone drinking must be 21 or older, and the driver never drinks. If anyone on board is under 21, no alcohol at all. You can read the full explainer.

Holiday Events

Memorial Day Ceremonies

Valley communities host remembrances at the National Memorial Cemetery, civic centers, parade routes in Tempe, Mesa and Chandler and veteran memorial sites. We provide respectful transportation, family coordination and comfort for every generation.

Weekend Celebrations

The barbecue circuit with no designated-driver debates, plus Diamondbacks games and stadium transportation if the schedule lines up.

Beat the Heat Tips

  • Morning strategy: Lake departures at 6 or 7 AM, pool arrivals by 10 or 11, afternoon retreat to the air conditioning
  • Hydration: Pre-hydrate, keep drinking water, go easy on alcohol in peak heat. Our vehicles stock water
  • Sun protection: SPF 50 or higher, reapply often, hats, cover-ups and UV eyewear
  • Heat awareness: Know the signs of heat exhaustion, rest in shade and treat the vehicle as your refuge
